title: Itsy's Big Show
description: Pop bubbles, climb the spout with Itsy, find letters and numbers, and make sounds to make Itsy dance. Gets better the more they play.

title: Itsy & Sleepy Kart
description: A gentle 3D kart race through the Rainy Garden or along Sleepy Road. Drive with a flight-sim joystick on the computer, or drag the big circle on an iPad. No menus to fall into.
